Compute a stationary distribution, fit smoothed character transitions, score held-out text, and generate a sample.

## Part A · Worksheet (~40 min, pen and paper)

### Problem 1 — Stationary distribution

For $P=\begin{bmatrix}.8 & .2 \\ .4 & .6\end{bmatrix}$, solve $\pi=\pi P$ and normalize.

### Problem 2 — Path probability

With initial $(.6,.4)$, find $P(S,R,R,S)$.

### Problem 3 — Transition MLE

Derive the MLE row from counts $n_{ij}$ under the row-sum constraint.

### Problem 4 — Smoothing

Apply add-one prediction to counts $(8,2,0,0)$.

### Problem 5 — BPC

If test transitions receive probabilities $(1/2,1/4,1/8)$, compute total bits, BPC, and perplexity.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Solutions — open only after attempting everything

**1.** $\pi=(2/3,1/3)$.

**2.** $0.6(.2)(.6)(.4)=.0288$.

**3.** $\hat{P}_{ij}=n_{ij}/\sum_j n_{ij}$.

**4.** $(9/14,3/14,1/14,1/14)$.

**5.** Total 6 bits, BPC 2, perplexity 4.
:::
